title: Experiment 8 Statistical Inference Protocol & Cross-Policy Comparison

protocol_rules.r1_sequence_level_degrees_of_freedom: Single-sequence evaluations (TUM N=1, OpenLORIS N=1) lack population-level degrees of freedom. Frame-level paired tests are reported strictly as autocorrelated exploratory diagnostics.
protocol_rules.r2_random_seed_distribution: R3 RANDOM_K is evaluated across 10 reproducible random seeds (seeds 42..51); random variation is reported as mean +/- std.
protocol_rules.r3_effect_sizes: Report standardized Cohen's d effect sizes rather than uncalibrated p-values.
